nodes.label: Release Workflow (version bump + prerelease)
nodes.rationale: Bumps the version across all seven sources, refreshes lockfiles in parallel, pushes the bump to master, and creates a prerelease whose body carries a marked whats-new block (parsed by the app and changelog) plus the mobile-delivery marker. On failure it deletes the tag and reverts the bump with a revert commit, never a force-push, because branch protection forbids force-pushes to master.
